settings.title: Fine painting and log home staining for exceptional mountain homes.

settings.editor: High-end interior and exterior painting, plus log and timber home staining, restoration and chinking, from Vail to Aspen. Backed by a company that has been building log homes in these valleys since 1999.

Walls, ceilings, trim, doors, and specialty finishes, completed with the preparation, protection, and clean lines a high-end home demands. We work in occupied and unoccupied homes, coordinate with property managers, and keep you updated even when you're out of town.

background_image.alt: Freshly stained cedar fence and gate

settings.editor: Log home staining is where we started and what we're known for. We prepare the wood properly, apply premium stains and sealers, and handle the chinking, check sealing, and rot repair that keep a log home tight and protected. We build log homes, so we know what makes a finish last.

settings.title: Craftsmanship rooted in how mountain homes are built

settings.editor: Top Notch Painting is the painting and finishing division of Top Notch Logworks, which has been building log and timber homes and resorts across the Vail and Roaring Fork Valleys since 1999. That background shapes everything we do. We understand how mountain homes are built, how they move, and what high altitude, dry air, and intense sun do to a finish.

settings.html:
<script>
(function(){
  function init(){
    var root = document.getElementById('tn-featured'); if (!root || root.dataset.tnInit) return; root.dataset.tnInit = '1';
    var rows = root.querySelectorAll('.tn-row'), photos = root.querySelectorAll('.tn-f-photo');
    function select(i){
      rows.forEach(function(r){ r.setAttribute('aria-pressed', r.getAttribute('data-project') === String(i) ? 'true' : 'false'); });
      photos.forEach(function(p){ p.classList.toggle('is-active', p.getAttribute('data-project') === String(i)); });
    }
    var canHover = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(hover: hover)').matches;
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      var i = r.getAttribute('data-project');
      r.setAttribute('role', 'button'); r.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
      r.addEventListener('click', function(){ select(i); });
      r.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); select(i); } });
      if (canHover) r.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){ select(i); });
    });
    select(0);
  }
  if (document.readyState !== 'loading') init(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
})();
</script>

settings.title: Away for the season? We'll take care of it.

settings.editor:
Many of our clients aren't here full-time. We coordinate access with you or your property manager, send progress photos along the way, and finish the work before you arrive, with the home cleaned and ready to enjoy.

Winter is an ideal time for interior projects, when the house is quiet and schedules are flexible.
